tasks.title: Build the native macOS operator shell foundation
tasks.summary: Add the native SwiftUI shell, authoritative CLI resolution, packaged app bundle path, and honest operator-facing task naming over current CLI truth.
notes: Implemented: native SwiftUI shell, dev and packaged CLI resolution, packaged `SuperMover.app`, bundled `supermover` binary, and honest task naming over current CLI truth.
Non-goal: this task did not close LAN browsing, detached daemon lifecycle, or ongoing incremental sync.

tasks.title: Deepen structured operator review surfaces
tasks.summary: Replace raw stdout dependence for current review and lifecycle commands with structured cards for status/report/prune, health/drift, and daemon evidence.
notes: Implemented across commits `e7d1736`, `df2b100`, and `72b2441`: structured `status`, `report`, `prune review`, `health`, `drift list`, `daemon status`, and `daemon logs` cards.
Daemon surfaces remain durable lifecycle evidence, not live liveness or detached service management.
Non-goal: this task did not add mutating drift or prune approval workflows.

tasks.title: Add persisted drift review and narrow reconcile operator surfaces
tasks.summary: Wire structured app support for persisted drift acknowledge/resolve and narrow reconcile plan/apply without presenting it as broad automatic repair.
notes: Current working tree adds task launch, multi-id-aware reconcile input handling, and structured result cards for `drift acknowledge`, `drift resolve`, `reconcile plan`, and `reconcile apply`.
Aligned the app adapter back to CLI truth: `reconcile plan` keeps optional ids and `reconcile apply` keeps repeatable ids instead of app-only single-id narrowing.
Included a narrow daemon foreign-state test assertion fix so full-suite gate evidence stays stable without changing daemon status product semantics.
Acceptance boundary: persisted drift metadata mutation and narrow persisted-drift reconcile only.
Do not rename this surface into broad repair, detached daemon recovery, or ongoing sync.

tasks.title: Add prune approval lifecycle read-only operator surfaces
tasks.summary: Expose richer read-only prune lifecycle truth in the macOS shell through full `prune review` and `prune approvals` inventory surfaces.
notes: Current slice deepens the read model first: richer `prune review` plus `prune approvals` inventory before approval mutations.
Keep `prune review` as release-review truth with candidates, refusals, approvals, receipts, and read-only authorization contract; do not reduce it to approval inventory.
Current working tree adds `prune approvals` inventory plus richer `prune review` read-only cards for authorization contract, candidates, refusals, approval lifecycle, receipts, and artifact problems.
Non-goal: bypass existing approval/apply gates or turn compact status into a second full inventory surface.

tasks.title: Add prune approval artifact mutation surfaces
tasks.summary: Expose `prune approve` and `prune supersede` as explicit approval-artifact mutations after the read surface is stable.
notes: Current slice adds explicit approval id, soft-delete ids, reviewer, reason, and optional expiry inputs for artifact mutation only.
Current slice adds structured results for `prune approve` authoring and `prune supersede` review-state mutation.
Non-goal: `prune --apply --approval <id>` target deletion remains outside this mutation slice unless tracked separately.
